label: p1: fc (200,100) + 8 epochs, seed 3 of 8
notes: The clean network-shape test. p2 and p3 differed in TWO knobs -- fc (320,) + 8 epochs against fc (200,100) + 4 epochs -- so neither settled the two-hidden-layer thread p0 opened, and epochs is the one axis p0 found to move. p1 holds epochs at 8 and takes p3's network, which makes it a single-knob comparison against p2 (the network) and against p3 (the epochs) at the same time. Budget is 200M (12,207 rollouts of 16,384). That is BELOW both comparators -- p3 reached 215-231M and p2 255-271M -- so **both** comparisons truncate to 200M rather than only p2. Cheap, since every row is already on disk, but it is a truncation on each side and not a like-for-like horizon on either. Eight seeds because the p2/p3 attempt had eight and its sign test still came out 5 of 8.
